# GR Tiling & Bathroom Renovations

GR Tiling & Bathroom Renovations is a Dublin-based specialist in full bathroom renovations and professional tiling services. Founded and run by Gerard Ronan, the business serves homeowners across Dublin and surrounding areas. Known for clean work, honest pricing, and reliable timelines - no hidden costs, no surprises.

## Services

### Bathroom Renovations
Full bathroom renovation service including design, demolition, plumbing, tiling, and fitting. GR Tiling manages the full project from start to finish so homeowners only deal with one contractor. Specialisms include full bathroom strips and refits, ensuite renovations, wet room installations, accessible bathroom conversions, and tiling and finishing work as part of a full renovation.

### Tiling Services
Professional tiling for residential properties across Dublin. Services include floor tiling, wall tiling, bathroom tiling, kitchen tiling, shower tiling, and tile repairs. Works with all tile types and formats including large-format tiles, herringbone, and pattern tiles.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does a bathroom renovation cost in Dublin?**
The cost depends on the size of the bathroom, the layout, and the finishes chosen. A clear, upfront written quote is always provided before work begins, with no hidden costs.

**How long does a bathroom renovation take?**
Most bathroom renovations take between 1 to 2 weeks depending on size and complexity. A clear timeline is agreed before starting and adhered to.

**How much does a wet room installation cost?**
Every wet room is different depending on size, tile choice, drainage setup, and whether it is a new install or a conversion. A site visit and written quote are provided before any work begins.

**What is the Housing Adaptation Grant?**
The Housing Adaptation Grant is a scheme run by local councils in Ireland that can contribute significantly toward the cost of adapting a home for a person with a disability or mobility issue, including accessible bathroom work such as level-access showers and grab rails.

**How much does tiling cost in Dublin?**
Tiling quotes vary depending on tile size, pattern, surface condition, and complexity of the job. Written quotes are provided before work begins, including for standard kitchen splashbacks.

**Do you cover all areas of Dublin?**
Yes. GR Tiling works across Dublin and nearby areas. Contact to confirm availability for a specific location.

**Can you handle just the tiling, not a full renovation?**
Yes. Both full bathroom renovations and standalone tiling services are available, including bathroom tiling, floor and wall tiling, kitchen tiling, and tile repairs.

**Will the work area be kept clean?**
Yes. The site is tidied at the end of each day and left fully clean on completion.

**Do customers get a written quote?**
Yes. Every project comes with a written quote outlining the scope, timeline, and cost before any work begins.

**Is it better to repair or retile?**
It depends on the extent of the damage. A small number of cracked or loose tiles can often be repaired. If adhesive has failed across a larger area or there is recurring moisture damage, a full retile is usually the better long-term option. Honest advice is given on which makes more sense.

The business differentiates itself through transparent pricing, clean workmanship, and reliable scheduling - common pain points for homeowners dealing with renovation contractors in Dublin.
